title: ArtifactFinishRequest.v1
description: Finishes the attachment artifact_begin made: every file is checked (size, sha256, every segment) and the attachment is made only when all of them pass, in one step. Takes no operationKey: the attachmentId is the idempotency key. Finishing again with the same attachmentId returns the same attachment. It needs no session: it is bound to the upload by the attachmentId alone.
